'''Nicholas A. M. Monk''' is a physicist and mathematician.<ref name=":0">{{cite web |title=Nicholas Monk - The Mathematics Genealogy Project |url=https://mathgenealogy.org/id.php?id=84227 |website=mathgenealogy.org}}</ref>
He is Alexander von Humboldt Foundation German Research Chair at [[AIMS Ghana]] and Professor of Mathematical Biology at the [[University of Sheffield]] and the [[University of Ghana]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Prof. Nick Monk |url=https://aims.edu.gh/researcher/prof-nick-monk-2/ |website=AIMS Ghana}}</ref> He is known for his works on [[mathematical biology]], [[pattern formation]], and [[dynamical systems]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Nick Monk |url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=IGDfsa0AAAAJ&hl=en |website=Google Scholar}}</ref> He earned his PhD in 1994 from [[Birkbeck College, University of London]].<ref name=":0" /> His advisor was [[Basil Hiley]].<ref name=":0" />
